'''Banshees''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of flying predators native to the shadow world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. They were distinguished by their crab-like claws and their [[Bioluminescence/Legends|bioluminescent]] [[Color/Legends|green]] eyes, as well as other patches of bioluminescence on their bodies.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Bansheespecies.png|thumb|left|220px|A pair of banshees in flight]]
The banshees were a relatively large, winged predator native to [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], distinguished by their almost [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]]-like appearance and patches of bright [[Color/Legends|green]] bioluminescence on various parts of their bodies. They were strong, easily able to lift a fully-armored [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldier]] into the air,<ref name="darkness on umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> but were easily killed, as seen when one was impaled by the force of an [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension gun]] cable.<ref name="the general">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] staged their assault on the shadow [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], the clone troopers of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] came across several groups of these scavengers. One particular encounter was when the Legion was en route to the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital city]] and were attacked by a pair of these creatures-- one of which knocked [[Fives/Legends|ARC-5555]] to his feet and another carried away a trooper in its claws. Both banshees were killed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], although the clones would encounter the creatures several times afterward as they attempted to claim the soldiers for food or feed on the corpses of the [[Umbaran militia]] and clones themselves.
